coverage.qualification: The ES 8.8 license topic distinguishes Platform ingress/compute from the ES license, which adds no ingestion capacity. A representative issues the 30-day Essentials or 90-day Premier trial; Premier evaluation by an existing Essentials customer reverts to purchased Essentials at expiry. The edition table keeps SIEM capability groups separate from Premier native SOAR and UEBA. The public pricing page lists activity-based, workload and ingest models and separate standalone SOAR pricing; these do not establish individual eligibility, price, deployment permission or exact compatibility. Both live origins and their reports have not passed the registered reader check for this section.
